metadata.description: XeoMatrix skills for Tableau Next / Data 360: build semantic models as code, then package the whole app as an installable template that ships its own data.

plugins.name: tableau-next-semantics
plugins.description: BUILD THE MODEL. Pro-code toolkit for Tableau Next / Data 360: load CSVs as data streams and Data Lake Objects (with the load-time primary key), build semantic models over granular REST endpoints, wire up workspaces, and read visualizations and dashboards. Bundles thirteen skills, including the tbx-* family.

plugins.name: tableau-next-app-templates
plugins.description: SHIP THE APP. Package a finished Tableau Next app as an installable App Template Framework template that carries its own CSV data. On Create it builds the whole stack bottom-up in any org, from CSV to Data Stream to Data Lake Object to Semantic Model to visualizations to dashboard, with nothing pre-existing and no org-specific names baked in. Bundles the CSV_Example and superstore_demo_template references and the Superstore case study.
